description: Primary screen displaying the countdown timer and Start button. Enables students to begin a new 25-minute session or resume a paused session. Shows current timer state and provides the core interaction point for starting the timer.

props.text: Primary screen displaying the countdown timer and Start button. Enables students to begin a new 25-minute session or resume a paused session. Shows current timer state and provides the core interaction point for starting the timer.
Large, prominent display showing remaining time in MM:SS format (e.g., 25:00). Updates in real-time when timer is running.
Primary action button clearly labeled 'Start'. Visible and accessible on main screen. Initiates countdown from 25:00 for new sessions or resumes from current time for paused sessions.
Visual indication of whether timer is running or paused, derived from is_running state.
